name: Talisman of Elemental Fury

attunement.text: by a creature with at least 1 level in Druid

entries: This intricate talisman, shaped like an intertwining swirl of flames, water, and vines, hums faintly with primal energy. It allows druids to call upon the raw forces of nature.

Elemental Surge (Action, 1/day). Choose fire, cold, lightning, acid, or poison. Creatures within a 10-foot radius of a point you choose within 30 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus). On a failed save, they take 2d8 damage of the chosen type and suffer the matching rider: fire ignites for 1d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn; cold reduces speed by 10 feet; lightning prevents reactions until the end of their next turn; acid gives armor or shields a -1 AC penalty; poison poisons until the end of their next turn. Damage increases to 3d8 at 5th level, 4d8 at 11th level, and 5d8 at 17th level.
Elemental Ward (Action, 1/day). You summon a 20-foot aura for 1 minute. Allies in the aura are immune to being frightened or charmed, and either condition ends for them when the aura activates.
